rules.text: Rewards follow the total length of all the fish you catch during the event.
Each prestige gives 1 lure plus your Fishing Line bonus: 5 at level 1.
The Tacklebox makes one lure every 30 seconds plus its Speed value (60 seconds at level 1), and holds 5 lures plus its Size value.
You can receive at most 100 prestige lures a day plus your Bucket bonus; Tacklebox lures do not count. The count resets every day at 00:00 UTC.
Fishing Skill unlocks the species whose required level is below its value; every unlocked species is equally likely.
A catch's length is drawn evenly between the species' smallest and largest length, then multiplied by the Fishing Hook value.
Rarity is drawn from the rarity table at your bait value plus one.
A catch gives the coins its rarity is worth in the game's XP table.
Levels go from 1 to 10; level L gives the L-th value of its list, and going from L to L+1 costs the next cost in the list.
Lures you do not use stay in stock. The engine sets no limit on the stock (no limit was seen in game).
